repo_info.description: Python library to perform fault-injection attacks on microcontrollers

children.title: Faulty Cat
children.description: Low-cost open hardware EMFI tool from Electronic Cats built on an RP2040, offering both electromagnetic and crowbar voltage-glitching fault injection with single-shot and parameter-sweep campaign modes.

repo_info.description: Faulty Cat is a low-cost Electromagnetic Fault Injection (EMFI) tool, designed specifically for self-study and hobbiest research.

children.title: EM-Fault-It-Yourself
children.description: Motorized XYZ-stage EMFI platform targeting desktop and server SoCs (successfully attacked the AMD Secure Processor), with 2.5µm accuracy, 100mm travel, and a web UI for automated scanning campaigns. IEEE HOST 2022.

repo_info.description: EM-Fault It Yourself: Building a Replicable EMFI Setup for Desktop and Server Hardware

repo_info.description: Platform independent Near Field Communication (NFC) library

children.title: MFOC
children.description: Nested attack that recovers the remaining MIFARE Classic sector keys once one key is known; pairs with MFCUK.

repo_info.description: Mifare Classic Offline Cracker

children.title: MFCUK
children.description: Implementation of the Dark Side attack, recovering a first MIFARE Classic key when none is known.

repo_info.description: MiFare Classic Universal toolKit (MFCUK)
